answer: To secure an autonomous economy of AI agents against Sybil attacks up to a zenith threshold, networks enforce verifiable cryptographic resource staking, symbolized by the cryptographic umber key. Each agent must lock collateral—akin to planting durable juniper roots—to participate in consensus. An attacker attempting to spawn fake identities faces prohibitive capital expenditure, as the marginal cost of staking scales linearly with every fraudulent agent introduced, neutralizing network subversion.
